description_en: This operation retrieves the list of recommended managed rules for an account group
description_zh: 本接口用于获取推荐的账号组托管规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-recommend-managed-rules --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 200 --region-ids-scope cn-hangzhou --exclude-region-ids-scope cn-shanghai --resource-group-ids-scope rg-aekzc7r7rhx0000 --exclude-resource-group-ids-scope rg-bnczc6r7rml0000 --resource-ids-scope lb-5cmbowstbkss9ta030000 --exclude-resource-ids-scope lb-t4nbowvtbkss7t3260000 --selected-managed-rule-identifiers ram-user-mfa-check-v2,ram-user-last-login-expired-check --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateRecommendManagedRules

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. It indicates the position where the current query begins. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Default value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The rule is effective only for resources in the specified region. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,).

This parameter applies only to rule templates
parameters.help_zh:
规则仅对指定地域ID中的资源生效。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

仅适用于规则模板
parameters.name: region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package is invalid for resources in the specified region. The resources in the specified region are not evaluated. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包对指定地域内资源无效，即不对该地域内资源执行评估。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule is effective only for resources in the specified resource group. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule is invalid for resources in the specified resource group. The resources in the specified resource group are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源组ID中的资源无效，即不对该资源组内的资源评估。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule is effective for the specified resource. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源ID生效。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en:
The rule is invalid for the specified resource. The specified resource is not evaluated. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,).

This parameter applies only to rule templates
parameters.help_zh:
规则对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

仅适用于规则模板
parameters.name: exclude_resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
